edges: Ariel Castro was sentenced to life in prison plus 1,000 years for a heinous crime but committed suicide in his prison cell.
Dr. Jan Gorniak reported that Ariel Castro committed suicide by hanging himself with a bedsheet.
Ariel Castro was being held at the Correctional Reception Center.
Kathryn Joseph stated that the women held captive by Ariel Castro are aware of his suicide.
Juan Alicea stated that the family was not notified about Ariel Castro's death until 1 a.m.
Michelle Knight described her experience of being held captive by Ariel Castro.
Amanda Berry was one of the women held captive by Ariel Castro.
Georgina DeJesus was also one of the women held captive by Ariel Castro.
Maria Castro-Montes expressed her grief upon hearing the news of Ariel Castro's death.
Barb Johnson was the first police officer on the scene when the women were rescued from Ariel Castro.
Dr. Gerald Maloney was in the emergency room when the victims arrived.
